info.name: The KbCart V2
info.description:
Complete API collection for The KbCart backend.

Base URL: {{baseUrl}}/api/v1

## Auth Flow
1. Register main user (POST /auth/admin/register)
2. Login as admin/firm (POST /auth/login)
3. Token is returned → set as Bearer token

## Roles
- **admin**: User management
- **firm (GST/Non-GST)**: All master + transaction endpoints

## Login Credentials (Seed Data)
| Role | Username | Password |
|------|----------|----------|
| Admin | admin_ramesh | Admin@1234 |
| GST Firm | gst_ramesh | Test@1234 |
| Non-GST Firm | nongst_ramesh | Test@1234 |
| Staff GST | gst_suresh | Staff@1234 |

request.description: Check if server is running. No auth required.

item.name: Categories
item.description:
Category master CRUD.

Categories group brands. Each category has a list of brand_ids.

request.description: List all categories with pagination and search.
Create a new category. `brands` is an optional array of brand ObjectIds.
Get a single category by ID.
Update a category. Partial update supported.
Delete a category. Removes brand associations.

item.name: HSN
item.description:
HSN (Harmonized System of Nomenclature) code master.

Each HSN has a gst_rate that applies to all items in a brand when HSN is assigned to that brand.

query.description: Search by HSN code or description

request.description: List all HSN codes with pagination. Searchable by code or description.
Create a new HSN code. hsn_code & gst_rate are required.
Get a single HSN code by ID.
Update an HSN code. Partial update supported.
Delete an HSN code. Unsets hsn_id from any brands referencing it.

item.name: Brands
item.description:
Brand master CRUD.

Each brand has:
- discount1 (GST discount: normal + special %)
- discount2 (Non-GST discount: normal + special %)
- hsn_id (optional, links to HSN for GST rate)

request.description: List all brands with pagination. HSN is populated.
Create a new brand with discount structure and optional HSN.
Get a single brand by ID. HSN is populated.
Update a brand. Partial update supported.
Delete a brand. Unsets brand_id from items, removes from category brand_ids.
Update only the discount fields on a brand. Values must be 0-100.
Get all brands + their discounts + HSN for a specific category.

item.name: Items
item.description:
Item master CRUD.

Items belong to a category, brand, and supplier (contact).
Image upload supported via multipart/form-data.

request.description: List items with pagination and search.

Create an item. Uses multipart/form-data for optional image upload.

Required: item_name, sale_rate.
Optional: purchase_rate, mrp_rate, gst_percent, discount, stock, threshold, category_id, brand_id, contact_id, is_gst, image.
Get a single item by ID with populated category, brand, contact.
Update an item. Partial update supported. Uses multipart/form-data.
Delete an item permanently.
Get items where stock is at or below threshold.
Update stock quantity for an item.

item.name: Contacts
item.description:
Contact master CRUD (parties + suppliers in one model).

type: "party" or "supplier"

Parties can have: category_id, transport_id
Both can have: category_id

Balance tracking: negative = due, positive = overpaid.

request.description: List all contacts with pagination, search, and type/balance filters.
Create a party. category_id, transport_id, and area_id are optional (party-only for transport_id and area_id).
Create a supplier contact.
Get a single contact (party or supplier) by ID.
Update a contact. Partial update. Set transport_id or area_id to null to unassign.
Delete a contact. Parties with active challans/unpaid bills cannot be deleted.
Get contacts with negative balance (due amount).
Get contacts with positive balance (overpaid).
Get the current balance of a contact.
Manually adjust contact balance. operation: "add" or "subtract".

item.name: Agents
item.description:
Agent (salesman) master CRUD.

Every agent is associated with a party (contact of type 'party'). party_id is required.

request.description: List agents with pagination. party_id is populated.
Create an agent (salesman). party_id is required and must be a contact of type 'party'.
Get a single agent by ID. party_id is populated.
Update an agent. Partial update supported.
Delete an agent.

item.name: Transports
item.description:
Transport master CRUD.

Transports can be assigned to parties via contact.transport_id.

request.description: List transports with pagination and search.
Create a new transport. All fields except name are optional.
Get a single transport by ID.
Update a transport. Partial update supported.
Delete a transport.

item.name: Areas
item.description:
Area master CRUD.

Areas group city/state/pincode with an optional agent and transport.
Areas are assigned to parties via contact.area_id.

request.description: List areas with pagination and search.
Create an area. agent_id and transport_id are optional.
Get a single area by ID. Populates agent and transport.
Update an area. Partial update. Set agent_id or transport_id to null to unassign.
Delete an area. Unlinks all parties referencing this area.

item.name: Challans
item.description:
Challan (delivery note) CRUD.

Requires: Firm token (GST or Non-GST).

Types: sale | purchase
- Sale challans auto-apply brand discounts
- Purchase challans auto-update stock & mark items with supplier's is_gst

request.description: List sale challans (unconverted only). Requires firm token.
List purchase challans. Requires firm token.

Create a sale challan. Brand discounts are auto-applied.

Required: challan_type, contact_id, items (array with item_id, quantity, rate).
Create a purchase challan. Auto-updates item stock and marks items with supplier's is_gst.
Get a single challan by ID with populated items and contact.
Update a challan. Cannot update converted challans.
Delete a challan. Cannot delete converted challans.
Get all unconverted sale challans for a party. Used before creating a bill.
Record a payment against a challan. amount must be > 0.

item.name: Bills
item.description:
Bill management.

Bills are created from unconverted sale challans.
Requires: Firm token.

request.description: List bills with pagination and optional filters.

Create a bill from unconverted challans.

Required: contact_id, challan_ids (array).
Optional: apply_balance (deduct party balance), delivered_amount (partial delivery).
Get a single bill with populated contact and challans.
Get aggregate bill summary (total, paid, due, etc.).
Get bills filtered by status. Status in URL: due | partial | paid.
Get all bills for a specific party/contact.
Record a payment against a bill. Updates payment_status automatically.
Process a return against a bill. Adjusts bill total and party balance.
Delete a bill. Reverts challans to unconverted and restores party balance.
Get general dashboard data. Works with any token (admin or firm).

Get firm-specific dashboard with period filtering. Requires firm token.

Periods: today, monthly, yearly.

item.name: Reports
item.description:
Purchase and sales reports.

Requires: Firm token.

request.description: Get purchase report with date range. Returns total purchase amount, supplier count, challan count, and top 5 suppliers.
Get sales report with date range. Returns total sales amount, party count, bill count, and top 5 parties.
